title: Counterfactual History and Retrospective Evaluation
goal: Weigh counterfactual historical outcomes and express past-tense regret or doubt about earlier events with the pluperfect subjunctive.
grammar: Pluperfect subjunctive (hubiera / hubiese + participle) in historiographical counterfactuals and retrospective clauses

items: I can formulate counterfactual historical conditions using *si* + *hubiera/hubiese* + participle and the conditional perfect.
I can express past-tense regret, disbelief or doubt about earlier historical events using the pluperfect subjunctive.
I can discuss historical preservation and legacy using *historiografía*, *conmemoración*, *posteridad* and *anacronismo*.
